messages:
nina: Quick onboard check — pushed carcher-30b weights to gs://redwood-models/carcher/30b/v1. Noticed tokenizer emits NBSP (U+00A0) in some samples which breaks token boundaries around em-dash. Serving config is at s3://redwood-configs/carcher-30b/serve.json. RoPE scale currently proposed 1.03 (default 1.0). Model uses GQA with some MQA layers. Can eng-runtime run a preflight validation and flag any runtime-incompatible settings? cc @marcus @olivia
marcus: Got it, will run the runtime validator tonight. Is there a minimal repro for the NBSP tokenization issue?
nina: Yep — minimal repro: "Hello\u00A0world—how are you" tokenizes to ["Hello", "\u00A0world", "—", "how", "are", "you"] which causes prefix cache splits in long-context tests. Paste tiny python snippet:
```python
text = "Hello\u00A0world—how are you"
print(tokenizer.encode(text))
```
olivia: FYI the config lint currently enforces `positional_scale <= 1.05`. For RoPE extrapolation (2048 -> 8192) we sometimes need >1.0. If you really need 1.03 that's within our tolerance but will trigger a lint warning.
sam: Notes: if GQA present, ensure `qk_layout: gqa` and `qk_groups: 16` in serve config. For mixed MQA/GQA models set `enable_mqa_fallback: true` so runtime can pick compatible kernels.
marcus: Starting `runtime-check --config s3://redwood-configs/carcher-30b/serve.json` now. Will post findings.
infra-bot: runtime-check job queued (job id rc-78921). ETA ~2m.
marcus: Run complete — two warnings: 1) tokenizer contains NBSP tokens (warning) 2) RoPE scale 1.03 OK but lint-exceeded. Also found qk_groups mismatch: model expects 16 but config had 8.
nina: Thanks — I'll update config to qk_groups:16 and relax lint threshold for this model. Also will add a tiny preprocess normalizer to replace NBSP with regular space while we patch the tokenizer. Plan to push a rev2 serve.json. Any objections to bypassing lint for canary?
olivia: :thumbsup: Go ahead with bypass for canary, but add a regression eval that catches NBSP tokenization.
sam: Ping me when canary is up; I'll watch KV cache behavior. NBSP splitting tends to reduce prefix cache hit rates.
marcus: Canary deploy started (canary id rc-78921). Posting infra logs...
deploy-bot: canary rc-78921: replica-1 OK, replica-2 crashloop (kernel mismatch), replica-3 pending. Rolling fallback to quantized variant.
nina: Uploaded corrected serve config and tokenizer patch to gs://redwood-models/carcher/30b/v1/rev2/serve.json and gs://redwood-models/carcher/30b/v1/rev2/tokenizer.json. Will trigger canary redeploy.
olivia: Nice — once rev2 is healthy let's add a lint rule to detect NBSP in tokenizer vocab during model onboarding.
sam: Created issue RED-INT-1543 to track tokenizer lint + preprocess hook.
marcus: Rev2 canary looks green. No more crashloops. NBSP still reproducible but runtime preprocess normalizes `\u00A0` -> ` ` and cache behavior stable. Recommend merging rev2 after another smoke run.
nina: Thanks all — I'll run the smoke tests and merge if clean. Appreciate the fast checks!
